// everything here is optional: with no config file at all the plugin uses these exact defaults
// states: ORDER IS THE WORKFLOW. task.sh only moves a task forward through this list; 'blocked' is reachable from anywhere and leads back anywhere. Name as many or as few as your process really has.
// advanceTo: which state each phase ends in, so the skills pass @spec / @implement instead of a literal state name.
// specBaseline: 'git' reads spec.md's version in HEAD to catch renumbered RF/AC headers. 'off' skips it — nothing else in this plugin touches git.
// crossCheck: the project's source of documented business truth, consulted before use cases are written. null or absent is a supported configuration meaning 'this project has none' — the step is skipped silently.
// featureModules: where a feature module lives per platform. {name} lowercases, {Name} capitalises. Absent means probe-scaffold-need.sh answers UNDECLARED rather than guessing that nothing needs scaffolding.
// implementAgents: platform key -> the subagent that owns that platform's code. Absent means mode=self: the loop does the work itself, same order.
// parityAgent: read-only subagent that audits cross-platform consistency once two platforms are green on one case. Only meaningful with more than one platform.
// testSeams: extra seams for a project whose test culture the built-in markers don't describe. key -> {marker: <regex>, glob: <file glob>}.
